sources.title: Lean attacks on two weak points of the ECDLP hardness graph
sources.citation: research/ecdlp_weakness_lean_20261104: LeftKernel.lean and HazardSeparation.lean, with README and AxiomAudit.lean.

nodes.label: Left-kernel index calculus: no rank condition, failure density exactly 1/q (Lean)
nodes.statement: Over a field, with relations a_i + b_i x = sum_j M_ij f_j: (i) more relations than factor-base columns give a nonzero left-kernel vector lam for every matrix M; (ii) any such lam gives sum lam a + x sum lam b = 0, so x = -(sum lam a)/(sum lam b) when sum lam b != 0; (iii) if lam is any nonzero-valued function of the logs a + b x alone, exactly q^(2n-1) of the q^(2n) pairs (a, b) have sum lam b = 0.
nodes.scope: Single target, relations built from target-dependent points R_i = a_i P + b_i Q with (a_i, b_i) uniform. Removes the rank condition from the linear-algebra step; it does not bound decomposition yield, and it does not apply when one relation set serves many targets (right-kernel reuse), where HEUR-RELATION-RANK remains load-bearing. The step 'a decomposition of R_i gives row M_i' is the definition of the factor-base logs and is not formalised.
assumptions: lam chosen from the relation points only

formal.notes: Compiled locally with lake env lean -o against Mathlib v4.34.1; repository proof gate (transitive axiom audit) runs on the landing PR.

nodes.label: Per-trial marginal bounds give the linear waiting time (Lean)
nodes.statement: On a finite probability space, if each trial t <= N succeeds with marginal mass at most eps (trials may be correlated or adaptive) and the waiting time is the index of a successful trial, then survival after n <= N trials is at least 1 - n eps, and E[min(tau, N)] >= N/2 whenever N eps <= 1/2.
nodes.scope: Same conclusion as JKSSTExpectedTrials.truncated_expectation_ge_half_horizon without its conditional-hazard recurrence. Constant 1/2 instead of the geometric sum; asymptotically the same Omega(1/eps) wait.
assumptions: Waiting time is the index of a successful trial

formal.notes: Compiled locally with lake env lean -o against Mathlib v4.34.1; repository proof gate runs on the landing PR.

nodes.label: 'Per-trial success bounds give the conditional-hazard recurrence'
nodes.statement: Overbroad inference: if every trial succeeds with probability at most eps, then survival masses satisfy the history-uniform recurrence (1 - eps) s(n) <= s(n+1).
nodes.scope: The inference behind treating a one-shot bound as a geometric waiting time (protocol corpus ONE-SHOT-REPEAT; JKSST audit open item 7). Refuted by a three-point model; the conclusion it was used for survives by THM-HAZARD-MARGINAL-SUFFICES.

nodes.label: Three-point model: marginals <= 1/3, hazard recurrence fails (Lean)
nodes.statement: Omega = Fin 3 uniform, outcome k succeeds exactly at trial k+1: every trial's marginal success mass is at most 1/3, the recurrence with eps = 1/3 fails at n = 1 (4/9 > 1/3), and E[min(tau, 3)] = 2.
nodes.scope: Finite countermodel to the inference only; the waiting time in the model is still linear.

formal.notes: Compiled locally with lake env lean -o against Mathlib v4.34.1; repository proof gate runs on the landing PR.

nodes.label: Each adaptive xedni trial, as run, succeeds with marginal probability O(1/p)
nodes.statement: For the adaptive trial process actually run (lifts possibly selected using earlier failures), every individual trial succeeds with marginal probability at most the one-shot bound C0/p.
nodes.scope: Replaces ASM-XEDNI-HAZARD-RECURRENCE under the obstruction: by THM-HAZARD-MARGINAL-SUFFICES this weaker per-trial statement already gives the linear wait. Adaptive lift selection could still raise a trial's marginal above the fresh one-shot bound; that is the remaining open bridge.

edges.statement: With target-dependent (left-kernel) relations no rank condition is needed and failure has density exactly 1/q; the heuristic is load-bearing only for relations reused across targets.
Kernel-checks the 'much easier to analyze rigorously' left-kernel alternative this survey statement names.
The assumption 'enough independent relations' is unnecessary for single-target left-kernel index calculus: |F| + 1 relations always suffice.
The waiting-time step of the obstruction follows from per-trial marginal bounds by a union bound.
The recurrence is stronger than the obstruction needs; the per-trial marginal statement suffices.
The countermodel half of this protocol-corpus item is kernel-checked; its repair is THM-HAZARD-MARGINAL-SUFFICES.
